lines.3: 「Hey. Here I am, just like I promised.」
lines.6: 「You keep forgetting because all you remember is that my name sounds like some kind of island.」
lines.8: She was just going to ignore me, huh?
lines.9: 「All right, before you change your mind. This way, this way.」
lines.11: 「Are the places where you were hit yesterday all right?」
lines.15: 「Wait, wait! Fine. It hurts a little, but there won't be any lasting damage. It's nothing.」
lines.18: Yashi kept her distance from me, but followed without falling behind.
lines.19: Man, having her walking behind me made quite an impression.
lines.20: Still, I'd pulled off the recruitment beautifully.
lines.22: 「Hey, you didn't take some embarrassing picture and blackmail her, did you?」
lines.24: 「Give me a copy of the picture too!」
lines.26: I drove the retort home with a solid thump.
lines.27: Fukahire staggered sideways and bumped into the shoulder of someone from the martial arts club.
lines.30: 「Huh? Monkey face, glasses... You're the bastard who hit on my little sister outside the school gates this week! I've finally got you. Come with me!」
lines.32: 「Please try not to kill him, senpai.」
lines.34: 「If you're going to say something, then save meeeee!」
lines.35: 「You brought this on yourself, so no.」
lines.36: 「...And so, I present Nagomi Yashi, first-year.」
lines.38: 「Right, right. The deal is that she's only a substitute until we find a permanent member.」
lines.39: 「(Wow. Her bust really is close to ninety centimeters.)」
lines.41: 「Fast as ever with the decisions, I see.」
lines.44: 「Princess, she's only a substitute... Is that all right?」
